name: run_operation_until_done
description: Calls several subroutines and library calls, starts an operation with the argument 90, then polls a call until it returns zero. Afterwards it stores 2400 in a global variable.

name: apply_first_stored_value
description: Passes a value saved in a global slot to a library call, then makes two argument-free calls to finish. Returns with no result.

name: apply_second_stored_value
description: Passes a second global value slot to the same library call used by its neighbour, then makes two argument-free calls. Returns with no result.

name: process_strided_grid_rows
description: Runs a subroutine and two library calls, then loops over a limit held in a global, stepping by a value taken from an argument. Each cell triggers library calls, and each row triggers a subroutine that receives values from the two pointer arguments.

name: allocate_320x200_bitmap
description: Allocates a 320 by 200, one-plane block through a library call. It keeps the returned structure, reads a pointer from one of its fields, and sets a flag byte to 1 in the block that pointer refers to.

name: pass_stored_bitmap_to_subroutine
description: Passes the structure pointer saved by the allocation routine to a subroutine and returns.

name: run_subroutine_between_library_calls
description: Calls a system library routine, then a subroutine, then a second library routine, all without arguments.

name: blit_rows_from_two_sources
description: Walks the rows of a source array from the last row back to the first. For each row it sets the blitter masks and modulos, loads the source, destination and first-operand pointers, starts a full-width blit with a fixed control word, and waits until the blitter is idle before the next row.

name: resolve_entries_skipping_markers
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of values. The dash-filled marker value stores zero in the output list, and every other entry is replaced by the result of a library lookup into a parallel output list.

name: handle_score_entry_screen
description: Stores its argument, then compares the score against the stored score table. Depending on the result it shows a screen with the 'Enter your name:' prompt or the 'scores' display, calls many drawing and input subroutines, and waits for input to change.

name: initialize_eight_record_table
description: Waits until a device check succeeds, then fills an eight-entry table of 18-byte records with blank values and a sentinel score. It writes the table out through device calls and stores pointers to each record in an index array.

name: insert_score_into_ranked_table
description: Finds the insertion position for a value among eight ranked entries. It compares in descending order when the mode flag is 3 and in ascending order otherwise. It shifts the record pointers to open a slot, stores the value there, records the position, and calls a subroutine with the new entry.

name: write_score_table_to_device
description: If a device check succeeds, writes each of the eight score-table record pointers out as an 18-byte entry, then closes the device.

name: draw_results_table_screen
description: Draws a results screen whose heading and column titles depend on a mode value: average lap times, fastest lap times, or tournament points. It then prints eight rows, formatting each name, car and time or points value with a formatted string call.

name: load_hiscore_and_status_assets
description: Loads the high-score and status resource files by name, looks up a tagged resource and releases it, and in non-special modes loads one more named resource chosen from a table. Releases the lookups it made.

name: load_track_and_song_assets
description: Sets a loading flag and releases two previously loaded resources. It then loads the named pit-stop, track and shape assets and the song, starts the song, waits for that call to finish, and releases the old resources.

name: run_three_choice_menu
description: Runs a menu loop where cursor up and down move a highlighted choice among three entries with wraparound, redrawing the highlight each time. Return confirms the choice and the escape key exits, returning its code.

name: animate_bitmap_copy_sequence
description: Fills a table of 52 pointers from a subroutine, then runs one or two passes of 22 steps. Each step waits briefly, updates pointers from the table, and copies a 320 by 200 bitmap between two buffers. It finishes by writing a formatted value to the display.

name: flash_text_five_times
description: Draws a text string at the given position five times, alternating between two colours with a short pause between each change. The last draw uses the first colour.

name: update_damped_motion_values
description: Updates a pair of stored motion values with decay: each is reduced by a fraction of itself when it is large enough, and one is adjusted toward a target derived from the other. Results are clamped to fixed limits and the routine returns zero or the computed value.

name: copy_selected_block_to_buffer
description: Picks a source block from a pointer table using the current index, then copies it word by word into a fixed buffer, stopping after a fixed count.

name: copy_saved_word_to_state
description: Copies one saved 16-bit value from a global location into a state word, with no other work or return value.

name: tick_countdown_and_toggle
description: Decrements a countdown word by a step each call and clears it when it reaches zero, while comparing two other state words. It then flips a toggle word and makes subroutine calls on each branch.

name: update_position_from_lookup_tables
description: Moves a stored value one step toward a target, then updates a pair of position words using two lookup tables indexed by a scaled value. Each call alternates between two update phases and invokes subroutines to apply the result.

name: register_handler_with_parameters
description: Stores a value derived from a byte global, makes subroutine calls, and then registers a handler routine together with a parameter pointer and three numeric parameters in a fixed structure, with a library call before and after.

name: copy_table_entry_and_call
description: Copies one 32-bit entry from a table, selected by an index register, into the slot just before a pointer, then makes a library call with a zero argument.

name: run_four_subroutines_in_order
description: Makes four argument-free calls to subroutines in a fixed order, passing no data and using no result.

name: dispatch_display_request_by_status
description: Checks a status word and, when its low four bits equal 7, selects one of two data blocks based on flags. It passes the chosen block through a stored object's function table and makes a second method call on that object.

name: run_three_subroutines_then_finish
description: Makes three argument-free subroutine calls in order, then a fourth call to another routine, without passing data.

name: register_two_handlers_and_run
description: Registers two handler routines with their parameter blocks through library calls, then makes a subroutine call and a branch. The branch makes one or two more library calls depending on a stored counter and a mode value.

name: copy_entry_then_register_handler
description: Copies one 32-bit table entry, selected by an index register, into the slot before a pointer. It then registers a handler routine with a parameter block, makes a library call, and runs a subroutine followed by a branch that makes one or two more library calls depending on a stored counter and mode value.

name: copy_entry_then_run_branch
description: Copies one 32-bit table entry, selected by an index register, into the slot before a pointer. It then makes a library call and a subroutine call, followed by a branch that makes one or two more library calls depending on a stored counter and mode value.

name: invoke_stored_object_methods
description: Calls two functions from a stored object's function table, one after the other, with no arguments.

name: shift_three_stored_words
description: Moves three 16-bit state words each into the slot before it, shifting the block down by one slot.

name: fetch_status_release_if_set
description: Calls a routine that returns a value in its upper half. If that half-word is nonzero it passes the full value to a second routine, then returns the half-word.

name: fetch_status_subroutine_release
description: Calls a routine that returns a value in its upper half. If that half-word is nonzero it runs a subroutine with the value, calls a second routine, and returns the half-word.

name: run_mode_dispatch_loop
description: Initializes a set of state words, then loops on a four-bit mode code. Codes one, and seven or zero, end the loop, while codes two and three each call a routine and, when its result is zero and a flag is still clear, set the flag and call a second routine. Each pass updates timing words and calls drawing or input subroutines.

name: run_library_call_sequence
description: Makes a fixed sequence of nine calls to library routines and subroutines, without arguments or a result.

name: clear_state_words_after_subroutines
description: Makes three argument-free subroutine calls, zeroes two state words, then calls a routine twice with a subroutine call between each. Ends with a final subroutine call.

name: clear_state_words_call_pair
description: Zeroes two state words, then makes two calls to the same routine with a subroutine call between them.

name: run_three_subroutine_calls
description: Makes three argument-free calls to subroutines in order: a first call, a second call, and a final call. No data is passed and nothing is returned.

name: reset_two_words_after_subroutine
description: Makes a subroutine call and a library call, then zeroes two state words.

name: load_indexed_track_entry
description: Sets a sentinel word and copies a pointer from a table selected by an index. It derives several stored addresses and offsets from two table entries, then computes two position words from a stored value.

name: wait_for_return_key
description: Returns at once when a mode word is nonzero. Otherwise it polls an input routine until it reports the Return key code.

name: wait_with_timeout_for_return
description: Sets a countdown of 90 passes, then runs a set of library and subroutine calls on each pass. It returns early if a mode word is set or the Return key is pressed, and stops when the countdown runs out.

name: initialize_race_state_words
description: Clears a large set of state words and sets several to fixed starting values, including a counter of 400 and two values of 800. It then clears a block of motion words and copies start-position values from one of two tables, chosen by a flag.

name: reset_partial_race_state
description: Sets three words to 100 and clears several other state words. It copies start-position values from one of two tables, chosen by a flag, in the same way as its neighbouring setup routine, and makes one call to an empty stub that does nothing.

name: process_five_display_entries
description: Makes five calls, each passing a stored object pointer together with two buffer addresses from the state block, then makes two argument-free subroutine calls.

name: run_paired_calls_with_subroutines
description: Calls the same library routine twice, then calls a second library routine, two subroutines, and a final library routine, with no arguments.

name: service_pending_status_calls
description: Checks a status routine and, depending on a flag, makes one of two library calls. If a pending word is set, it calls another library routine and clears the pending word.

name: make_single_library_call
description: Makes one argument-free library call and returns.

name: run_subroutine_then_library_call
description: Makes a subroutine call, then a single argument-free library call.

name: find_smallest_difference_entry
description: Starts a best-difference value at 1000, then scans a table of entries. For each one it takes the absolute difference from a stored value, keeping the smallest difference and the direction of the entry that produced it. It also keeps the largest value seen in a second table.

name: tick_timer_and_fire_callback
description: Increments a counter on each call. When a flag is clear it advances a second counter and decrements a timer; on expiry it reloads the timer from a stored period, calls a stored function pointer, and makes two subroutine calls.

name: advance_timer_until_limit
description: Returns through a subroutine when a mode word equals 3. Otherwise, when a state word exceeds 3500, it adds a step to a timer word until a limit is reached, then sets the mode to 3 and a marker to -1. At or below 3500 it decreases the timer by the argument, clamping it at zero.

name: decrement_counter_and_check_wrap
description: Clears one state word and subtracts the argument from a counter, then makes a subroutine call. If the counter's unsigned value is at or above a fixed high limit, it is reset to zero before that call.

name: compute_capped_target_value
description: When a mode word is set, a state word is not one and a counter is below six, it multiplies two byte values, raises the product to at least 800, and stores it as a target. The target is capped by a stored limit.

name: advance_counters_and_refresh
description: Advances a counter by eight and increments a second counter unless the mode word is seven. It clears two state words, makes subroutine calls (one only when a flag is zero), then makes a library call.

name: process_key_input_frame
description: Reads a key code and counts idle frames, forcing a state change after 1999 idle frames. An escape code or a set flag returns to the default state, one key code toggles a word, and any other code makes a subroutine call. It then updates two key-derived words from tables and makes two subroutine calls.

name: pass_subroutine_value_when_flagged
description: Calls a subroutine that returns a flag. When the flag is nonzero it calls a second subroutine for a value and passes that value to a library routine.

name: update_motion_state_per_frame
description: Runs a loop of motion updates, one per step count. It decrements a timeout that can switch the mode, accumulates position and velocity words with scaled fixed-point arithmetic, and reads the next segment record from a table, updating limits and flags from its bytes. It decreases a counter when that counter is nonzero.

name: toggle_flags_by_code
description: Toggles one flag when the argument is 100 and another when it is 109, clearing the argument after each. The code 105 toggles a third flag. It then sets a fourth word to one.

name: select_state_code_from_flags
description: Chooses a state code from the current mode and flags, then uses a table indexed by that code. In mode seven it selects a fixed code unless a speed threshold is met. Otherwise it sets or clears flags and, when a candidate code passes its checks, loads a pair of words from a table and marks the selection. Returns the table value for the chosen code.

name: classify_distance_and_set_state
description: Stores its argument, then compares it with a stored value. A large negative difference sets a state to three and reduces a counter. A large positive difference, under one flag condition, resets a target and adjusts a counter, and otherwise a positive difference above a threshold sets another counter.

name: update_sum_and_nonzero_flag
description: Saves a 32-bit state value, then adds two shifted fractions of a stored word to another state word. It stores the low byte of the result in a byte and the high byte in a counter, and sets a flag to one when the high byte is nonzero and to zero otherwise.

name: step_toward_target_position
description: When a flag is set, moves two stored coordinate words one step of twelve units toward a target pair. Once both match, it clears the flags and loads a table value. Otherwise it adjusts a speed target and a counter, then updates a stored value from a table indexed by its high bits.

name: deplete_stored_value_from_table
description: Subtracts a table value, selected by a state index, from a stored word. If that would go negative the word is clamped at zero and a flag is set. It then subtracts a scaled amount from two other words.

name: update_state_from_pending_flags
description: Handles a pending flag: while it is set and a byte value exceeds 29 it calls a subroutine, otherwise it clears the flag. When another word is zero it returns unless a marker is set, in which case it clears a flag and calls a subroutine. Otherwise it adds a stored increment to a state word and calls a subroutine.

name: lookup_scaled_table_value
description: Takes a stored value, divides it by 128, and caps the index at 96. It returns a table entry at that index multiplied by the high byte of another stored word.

name: copy_indexed_pointer_to_slot
description: Copies one 32-bit pointer from a table, selected by a state index, into a fixed slot in the state block.

name: run_library_sequence_when_flagged
description: When a flag is set, makes three library calls in order, then a subroutine call. If a second flag is also set, it repeats a subroutine call until the returned value equals one.

name: run_three_library_calls
description: Makes three argument-free library calls in order, with no data passed and no result used.

name: run_three_calls_in_sequence
description: Makes three argument-free calls through the global jump table, in order, and returns the register values it received unchanged.

name: set_defaults_and_run_calls
description: Stores the constants 72 and 111 into two state words, then makes four subroutine calls. If a counter is not positive it makes three more calls, and it finishes with two further calls.

name: run_three_calls_mid_step
description: Makes three argument-free calls through the global jump table, in order, with a different middle call from its neighbours, and returns the register values it received unchanged.

name: run_three_subroutine_calls
description: Makes three argument-free calls through the global jump table in order, with a subroutine call in the middle, and returns the register values it received unchanged.

name: run_five_repeated_calls
description: Makes one argument-free call, then a second routine five times in a row, then a final call with no arguments.

name: process_table_entries_descending
description: Walks a table of entries from the highest index down in steps of two. For each entry it checks flags and a counter, derives positions and attributes from two tables, and calls a routine with those values, followed by two more calls.

name: process_table_entries_loop
description: Repeats the same descending walk over the entry table, with the same per-entry checks and calls, stopping when the index drops below a fixed bound. It returns the register values it received unchanged after the walk.

name: process_table_entries_restart
description: Makes another pass over the same entry table with the same per-entry handling, but restarts the scan from the top index whenever a stored index is matched. It returns when the index drops below a fixed bound.

name: walk_table_entries_from_top
description: Starts a descending walk over the entry table from the highest index, checking flags and a counter for each entry and calling routines with values derived from two tables. Ends with two more calls after each entry is handled.

name: walk_table_entries_stepwise
description: Walks the entry table one step at a time from a current index, decrementing a counter on each pass. It makes the same per-entry checks and calls, and returns when the index drops below a fixed bound.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: update_slot_entries_by_type
description: Loops over a block of slots, resetting per-slot counters and taking a state value from a small table when an entry is present. For each slot it branches on the entry's type code, making several subroutine calls and, for one type, a nested loop of steps bounded by per-slot limits.

name: walk_entries_second_entry
description: Re-enters the entry-table walk partway through, making the same per-entry checks and calls. It stops when the index is no longer positive or when the table bound is reached.

name: walk_entries_after_type_check
description: Re-enters the entry-table walk after its type check, handling the entry's type with a fixed set of calls and a nested step loop for one type. It advances to the next entry and returns when the table bound is reached.

name: walk_entries_resume_loop
description: Re-enters the same entry-table walk inside its loop, making the usual per-entry calls and advancing to the next entry. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_with_flag_update
description: Re-enters the entry-table walk and records a fixed value in a state word, then handles the entry's type code. For one code it sets a different fixed value in that state word and continues the walk.

name: set_offset_then_walk_entries
description: Sets a word from a table indexed by a stored value, makes a few calls, then continues a walk over the entry table. For each entry it skips empty ones and branches on the entry's code, using a fixed set of calls for low codes, a stepping loop for code five, and other call sets for the rest.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: walk_entries_with_run_loop
description: Makes two calls, then runs a stepping loop of calls over a span taken from the entry table when the index is below a fixed bound. It then continues the same walk, skipping empty entries and handling each code with a fixed set of calls, loops or further calls.

name: walk_entries_guarded_loop
description: Repeats the entry-table walk with the same per-entry handling, starting from a fixed set of calls. It skips empty entries and returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_run_then_resume
description: Runs a stepping loop of calls over a span from the table when the index is below a fixed bound, then continues the entry-table walk with the same per-entry handling. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_run_first
description: Starts with a stepping loop of calls over a span from the table, then continues the entry-table walk with the same per-entry handling. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_from_middle
description: Enters the entry-table walk partway through, making the usual calls and then handling each remaining entry by its code. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_guard_then_resume
description: Continues the entry-table walk after a guard check, skipping empty entries and handling codes with the usual fixed sets of calls and loops. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_with_value_check
description: Sets a state word to eight, makes a few calls, then computes a derived value for entries with a particular flag bit set, setting a word to 15 for one code. It then continues the same entry-table walk and returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: raise_stored_value_if_higher
description: Compares its argument with a stored word and, when they differ, raises that word to the argument if the argument is larger. It then makes one call.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: draw_clipped_bitplane_span
description: Clips a horizontal range to stored bounds, then for each column in range reads four bitplane pointers offset by a computed column. It combines the words in those planes with a mask taken from two lookup tables, using three subroutine calls.

name: merge_masked_bits_four_words
description: For four memory words, clears the bits selected by a mask and then sets those bits from four supplied values. The same mask is used for each word.

name: fill_four_buffers_then_merge
description: Writes four supplied values into successive words of four buffers over a counted run, then merges the final words with the same mask-based bit selection.

name: select_table_offset_and_store
description: Makes one library call, then selects a table value from one of two tables depending on a flag. It stores a second table value and a remainder computed from the index and that value, then makes three subroutine calls and a final library call.

name: make_single_library_call
description: Makes one argument-free library call and returns.

name: call_with_temporarily_set_value
description: Calls one routine, then stores a temporary value in a state word. That value is the argument, clamped to 22 when a flag is set and the argument is larger than 21. It makes a second call, restores the previous state word, and makes a final call.

name: iterate_list_until_negative_entry
description: Makes one call, stores the argument shifted left by seven into a state word, then calls a routine repeatedly while the current list entry is nonnegative, advancing along the list. It ends with a final call.

name: call_and_return_argument
description: Makes one argument-free call and returns the value it was given on the stack unchanged.

name: store_range_and_run_calls
description: Stores the difference between two arguments and a quarter of the first into two state words, then sets a third word to seven. It makes a series of calls, ending with a subroutine call.

name: store_four_values_then_subroutines
description: Calls one routine, then saves four argument-derived values in a small state block. It makes subroutine calls, one of which receives the difference between an argument and a stored value plus one, and ends with a final call.

name: update_block_every_eighth_step
description: Computes the difference between a counter and a saved value. On every eighth step it derives four words for a small block from two tables indexed by a stored index, then calls a routine twice to process them. On other steps it follows a second branch that makes further calls based on the remainder.

name: derive_block_and_process
description: Derives four words for a small block from two tables indexed by a stored index, selecting the table set by a flag. It then calls a routine twice to process the block.

name: derive_block_from_index
description: Derives four words for a small block from a stored index, a table entry and a second table, then calls a routine twice to process it.

name: run_three_calls_when_aligned
description: When the argument plus four is a multiple of eight, makes three argument-free calls in order. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: run_three_subroutine_calls
description: Makes three argument-free calls through the global jump table in order, with a subroutine call in the middle, and returns the register values it received unchanged.

name: run_three_calls_mid_step
description: Makes three argument-free calls through the global jump table, in order, with a different middle call from its neighbours, and returns the register values it received unchanged.

name: compute_table_offset_and_call
description: When a stored index is not 78, computes a value from a table entry and an offset and stores it. It sets a counter from a table when the index is below one, or otherwise derives a difference from a second table, then clears a word and makes one call.

name: store_argument_minus_table_difference
description: Stores the difference between an argument and a value derived from a table entry into a state word, clears a flag word, and makes one call.

name: walk_entries_from_inner_loop
description: Walks the entry table from an inner loop, applying each entry's code with a fixed set of calls, loops or further calls, and skipping empty entries. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_scaled_lookup
description: Walks the entry table, looking up a scaled value from a table for each entry before making the usual calls and loops by code. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_second_lookup
description: Walks the entry table, computing a second table lookup for each entry before handling its code with the usual calls and loops. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_descending_loop
description: Steps down through the entry table two indices at a time, handling flags and codes for each entry with the usual calls. It returns when the index drops below a fixed bound.

name: update_indexed_slot_from_pair
description: Stores the first of two values from a pointed-to pair into an indexed slot, unless the second differs from it and already matches the slot's current value, in which case the second is stored.

name: check_scaled_offset_range
description: Computes a scaled difference between a table entry and an argument, then tests it against a range of about plus or minus 32. Both branches return without storing or calling anything.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: compute_clamped_entry_index
description: Computes an entry index from a table difference and a stored value, keeps it even, raises it to at least 2 and caps it at 78, then stores it in a state word.

name: return_input_unchanged
description: Returns its first register value unchanged; the sign test it makes has no effect on the result.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without change.

name: update_state_when_not_final
description: When a stored index is not 38, computes a difference from a table entry. When the index is below one it resets the index to two and copies two values from table fields, otherwise it derives a second difference. It then stores the result, clears a flag word and makes one call.

name: store_argument_minus_table_entry
description: Stores a stored argument minus a value derived from a table entry into a state word, clears a flag word, and makes one call.

name: swap_saved_word_around_calls
description: Sets a flag word and makes two calls, then swaps a state word with a saved word around a block of calls to a library routine and to two methods of a stored object. It restores the swapped word, clears the flag, and makes two more calls.

name: swap_saved_long_around_subroutines
description: Sets two state words to minus one, swaps a 32-bit state value with a saved one, and makes three subroutine calls. It then swaps the values back and makes a library call.

name: accumulate_stepped_values_with_calls
description: Copies a state value into a running sum, then for each step in a block of words makes three calls. Each step stores the previous word plus a shifted copy of the running sum.

name: build_entry_tables_from_list
description: Fills a 20-word table with a large sentinel value, then walks a minus-one-terminated list. For each list entry it computes several derived words from table values and stores them in parallel arrays, making one call per entry.

name: fill_sentinel_slots_from_neighbours
description: Walks the slots from high to low and, wherever a slot still holds the large sentinel value, copies the values of six parallel arrays from the next slot.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without change.

name: record_adjacent_step_entries
description: Compares each entry with the one before it. When two neighbours differ by exactly one it records a value and a companion value in tables indexed by the entry; other differences make a call with the difference, plus a second call unless a flag bit is set.

name: record_run_of_step_entries
description: Stores a value and companion for an index, then scans forward for the next entry with a different value. A difference of exactly one is recorded, while other differences trigger a call with the difference.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without change.

name: scan_step_entries_with_calls
description: Makes a call with the difference between an entry and a stored value, then scans forward through the entries. Each differing neighbour either records a value for exactly one step or makes a call with the difference.

name: walk_entries_after_swap
description: Swaps two state words, resetting one to 38 under certain conditions, then runs the entry-table walk with the usual per-entry calls and loops. It returns once the index passes the table bound.

name: walk_entries_negated_offsets
description: Runs the entry-table walk with its per-entry checks, calls and loops, using negated offsets when reading table entries. It makes a library call before each pass.

name: walk_entries_reverse_lookup
description: Runs the entry-table walk with negated table offsets and the usual per-entry calls, loops and skip rules. It makes a library call at the start of each pass.

name: walk_entries_descending_entry
description: Steps down through the entry table two indices at a time, applying each entry's flags and code with the usual calls and loops. It stops when the index reaches zero or drops below two.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: walk_entries_with_negated_index
description: Walks entries from a negated index, storing the current index in a state word, and handles each entry's flags and code with the usual calls and loops. It returns once the index passes the bound.

name: walk_entries_with_scaled_index
description: Walks entries while recording the current index and a related value in state words. It scales each entry's index by two, looks up a value from a table, and then makes the usual per-entry calls and loops.

name: walk_entries_with_flag_calls
description: Walks the entry table downward in steps of two, making a library call when an entry's flag bit is set and another when an entry's code is four. It then continues the walk with the usual calls and loops.

name: walk_second_entry_table
description: Resets a state word and walks a second entry table from its top index, clearing per-entry counters and making the usual calls for each entry. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_from_inner
description: Continues the second entry-table walk from an inner loop, handling codes with a fixed set of calls and skipping the usual entries. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_run_first
description: Starts with two calls, then runs a stepping loop of calls over a span of the second entry table before continuing the walk. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_guarded
description: Makes a set of calls for each entry of the second table, with a guard check that skips the extra calls for some entries. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_with_value
description: Enters the second entry-table walk at its start, making the usual calls, then stores a computed value for entries with a flag bit set and continues the walk. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_reset_slot
description: Loads a state word from a table indexed by a stored value, then makes the usual calls and continues the second entry-table walk. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: walk_second_table_run_loop
description: Makes two calls, then runs a stepping loop over a span of the second table when the index is below a bound, and continues the walk. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_triple_calls
description: Makes three calls for each entry of the second table, handling skipped entries and codes as usual. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_run_entry
description: Runs a stepping loop over a span of the second table with calls on each step, then continues the walk. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_run_resume
description: Runs the stepping loop over a span of the second table, then enters the walk's main loop with three calls per entry. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_step_calls
description: Runs the second entry-table walk from its loop body, making three calls per entry and skipping empty entries. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_from_label
description: Enters the second entry-table walk partway through, making three calls and an extra pair when a parity bit is set, then continues with the usual entries. It returns once the index passes its bound.

name: walk_second_table_scaled_lookup
description: Walks the second entry table and, for entries with a flag bit set, stores a computed value built from two table entries. It makes the usual calls for each entry.

name: advance_capped_counter_step
description: When a mode word equals three, adds a step to a counter that resets to 48 once it exceeds 95, then makes three argument-free calls.

name: reset_state_and_run_calls
description: Stores a state value into a counter slot, sets two state words to minus one, then makes four calls.

name: fill_slots_with_running_sum
description: Loops over 39 indexed slots and makes four calls per step. It stores a running value into each slot, then updates the running value to a stored per-slot value plus a shifted copy of itself.

name: build_wide_entry_tables
description: Fills a 40-word table with a large sentinel value, then walks a minus-one-terminated list. For each entry it adds 160 to a stored value and derives several parallel values, making calls along the way.

name: fill_sentinel_slots_upper
description: Walks slots from index 78 down to 2 and, wherever a slot still holds the large sentinel value, copies the values of six parallel arrays from the next slot.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without change.

name: record_adjacent_second_entries
description: Compares each entry of the second table with the one before it. When two neighbours differ by exactly one it records a value and a companion value; other differences make a call with the difference.

name: record_run_second_entries
description: Stores a value and companion for an index, then scans forward through the second table for the next entry with a different value. A difference of exactly one is recorded, while other differences trigger a call with the difference.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without change.

name: scan_second_entries_with_calls
description: Makes a call with the difference between an entry and a stored value, then scans forward through the second table. Each differing neighbour either records a value for exactly one step or makes a call with the difference.

name: derive_parallel_arrays_from_values
description: Walks a block of values backwards and, for each one, stores the difference from a stored reference and a quarter-adjusted difference. It also stores the sum and a quarter-adjusted sum, in four parallel arrays.

name: decode_entry_record_fields
description: Reads a four-byte record selected by an index and stores its bytes into several state words for the current entry. It sets a counter and copies a timing value when a particular code range applies, then makes one call.

name: compute_entry_timing_value
description: Stores its argument as a current value, then computes a timing difference from a stored reference. The difference is adjusted by 89 when a flag bit is set, and a table-based factor is derived for the entry. It makes two calls.

name: store_scaled_entry_timing
description: Computes a timing difference for an entry, adjusted by 89 when a flag bit is set. It scales the result by a table factor shifted right five bits, stores it per entry, and negates it when another flag bit is set. It then makes one call.

name: store_scaled_entry_value_clamped
description: Scales a table value by a factor for each entry and stores the result per entry, negating it when certain flag bits are set. It derives a small code from the sign and size of the value and clamps the stored result.

name: add_scaled_value_with_clamp
description: Adds a stored value multiplied by 64 to a state word and clamps the result to plus or minus 22528. It then stores the clamped value.

name: set_state_to_limit
description: Stores the upper limit of 22528 into a state word.

name: return_input_unchanged
description: Returns its first register value unchanged; the sign test it makes has no effect on the result.

name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without change.

name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

name: return_without_action

name: interpolate_values_into_array
description: Stores a starting value in the first slot and fills the following slots with values interpolated from it toward a target, using an accumulator and a direction flag. When the start and target are equal it repeats the start value across all slots.

name: fill_stepped_values_with_carry
description: Fills a run of slots with values stepped from a starting value, accumulating a fixed increment and carrying whenever the accumulator passes a threshold. It writes one value per slot.

name: fill_stepped_values_with_carry
description: Fills a run of slots with values stepped from a starting value, accumulating a fixed increment and carrying whenever the accumulator passes a threshold. It writes one value per slot.

name: fill_slots_with_constant
description: Writes one 16-bit value into every slot of a run, counting down to zero.

name: initialize_object_records
description: Loops over a set of object records and sets each record's fields to default values. Those defaults include a start value taken from a stored base when a flag is set, plus fixed values such as 352 and negative 480.

name: fill_ten_entry_index_table
description: Advances a stored counter and copies it into three state words, then sets a state word from a table entry. It fills a ten-entry table with each index plus the low nibble of a subroutine call's result.

name: apply_table_nibble_to_object
description: Reads a byte from a table at an offset derived from a stored time value. A nonzero high nibble is scaled by three and stored into two object fields, and the low nibble decides whether further default fields are set.

name: update_object_offsets_by_threshold
description: If an object field is set, compares two neighbour values against a threshold of 4. When the condition applies it sets the object's offset and size fields to fixed values, using a quarter of a stored field along the way.

name: step_object_value_toward_target
description: Moves a stored object value toward a target. Below the target it uses a table lookup to choose a step, while above it by less than sixteen it snaps to the target, otherwise it steps down by sixteen.

name: update_positions_with_wrap
description: Loops over a run of entries, storing a running position into two arrays for each and advancing it. When a position passes a stored limit and the remaining distance is at least 40, it wraps by a stored step and adds that step to a cumulative entry.

name: update_active_objects_per_frame
description: When a mode flag is set and another flag is active, loops over ten object slots. For each active slot it makes subroutine calls and updates the slot's values from bit-packed fields, while empty slots keep the running position.

name: sort_entry_pairs_by_value
description: Makes passes over a block of stored values from the top index downward, swapping out-of-order pairs and moving their companion entries alongside. The scan repeats until the block is in order.

name: compute_consecutive_differences
description: Sets a fixed value of 500 in a state word, then stores the difference between each pair of consecutive values in a nine-entry array.

name: scan_entries_for_close_pairs
description: Scans a block of entries from index 18 downward. For entries whose value is below 16 it compares companion entries and their signs, and makes further checks against a limit of 24 before taking action.

name: update_close_pair_flags
description: When a mode flag is set, loops over ten entries with a value below three, compares the entries each one references, and acts when their difference is under 441.
